races.display_title: Emirates Autumn Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict: ROCK MONTREAL took a while to hit full stride and conceded first run but was noted finishing strongly when finding only one too good in listed company at Doncaster 4 weeks ago. He remains potentially smart, not least now tackling 1m for the first time and he rates a major player on his foray into Group company. Sergei Diaghilev found only Godolphin's Desert Castle too good in the Champagne Stakes and he's a major threat with the promise of more to come. ROCK MONTREAL (IRE) SERGEI DIAGHILEV (IRE) AL JABBAR (IRE)

races.display_title: Darley Dewhurst Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict: Having impressed when scoring on debut, DESERT CASTLE took the rise in class in his stride and looked a high-class colt in the making when impressively following up in the Champagne Stakes at Doncaster 4 weeks ago. Open to further improvement, he shades preference over Darkness Falls who is similarly improving at a rate of knots and already has a comfortable success at Group 1 level to his name. Great Barrier Reef can fill out third. DESERT CASTLE DARKNESS FALLS (IRE) GREAT BARRIER REEF (IRE)

races.display_title: Club Godolphin Cesarewitch Handicap (Heritage) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: NAVAL TRIBUTE has been most progressive since stepped up to 2m and is taken to pull out even more for this slightly longer trip and make it 5-7 in handicaps for his excellent trainer. Mountain Road could have fared better with the draw but is another who has really got back on the up since faced with 2m again and is second choice ahead of Sea Lantern , who is very much the unknown quantity, and last year's 1-2 Beylerbeyi and Dawn Rising . NAVAL TRIBUTE MOUNTAIN ROAD (FR) SEA LANTERN

races.verdict: Having landed the Scottish Triumph Hurdle at Musselburgh in January, MADE U BLUSH twice shaped well in handicaps thereafter, latterly when doing best of those from off the pace when fifth in the Swinton at Haydock in the spring. This has likely been her target since and she can exploit a handy-looking mark with the prospect of more to come. This is competitive though, with Way of Stars , Gallivanted , Treasure Planet and Tenter le Tout just a quartet of others to consider. MADE U BLUSH WAY OF STARS (IRE) GALLIVANTED (FR)

races.verdict: Plenty to consider but PRINCE RASAM 's all-weather record is a pretty good one and the strong feeling is that he can win a race from his current mark. races.display_title: Sky Bet Peter Nolan Handicap
races.verdict: Low-mileage 3-y-o WEFFAAG didn't need to improve when opening his account in a 6-runner maiden at Newcastle 3 weeks ago and with the third that day having advertised the form since, William Haggas's colt looks potentially well treated from an opening mark of 79 now handicapping. Frankies Dream needs things to drop right but he lurks on a handy mark so is feared. Last-time-out winners Canvas and Nyman are others to consider, with Metallo another to note. WEFFAAG FRANKIES DREAM (IRE) CANVAS

races.display_title: Sky Bet Sprint Trophy Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict: Andrew Balding's OLD IS GOLD has proved a different model since the visor went on and this front runner can make light of a 9 lb weights hike for his easy Newmarket success and complete a quick hat-trick. Ayr Gold Cup hero Pellitory continues in fine form and heads a long list of dangers with last year's winner Binhareer also a likely player. Coul Angel , Fine Interview , Toyotomi and Grasmere Boy all command plenty of respect too in this cracking sprint. OLD IS GOLD (IRE) PELLITORY BINHAREER (IRE)

races.verdict: STAG NIGHT was significantly better than the result on his recent return from a break at the Curragh and is taken to land this race for the second year running. Keke is another who is likely in much better form than his last couple of efforts at the Curragh might suggest and is feared most ahead of Johnny Murtagh 3-y-o Bay of Supremacy , who may strip fitter for his recent first outing in 4 months. STAG NIGHT (IRE) KEKE BAY OF SUPREMACY (IRE)

races.verdict: GAELIC SEER shaped well on her first start when third in a Ballinrobe bumper (form has been franked) and can build on it to get off the mark here. John McConnell's Maxios newcomer Miss Kobe could emerge as the main danger, although Streamhill has the form to play a big part if on her A-game. GAELIC SEER (IRE) MISS KOBE (IRE) STREAMHILL (IRE)
